newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mostly off, gasoline rebounds.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mostly off, gasoline rebounds.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly lower on Friday with gasoline rebounding late.
Gas oil slumped with cascading futures. Premiums were hurt by low end-user demand and good availability.
Gasoline recovered from an early crude-influenced selloff to end near unchanged, with a Eurograde barge trading late at $226 fob into a Rotterdam refinery.
Naphtha ended lower with volatile crude and gasoline masking what some traders said was solid petchem demand.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil was weaker. Barges were $4 weaker and traded around $114 fob ARA.
